meaningOfCompleted: The source reports an internal proof under its stated hypotheses and foundational inputs. This is separate from independent proof acceptance, external refereeing and novelty or priority certification.

commonScope.field: A fixed finite extension K/Q_p with the original absolute value.
commonScope.spaces: Good, Hausdorff, boundaryless, quasi-smooth analytic spaces, locally of pure dimension n, unless a statement imposes a narrower algebraic or model hypothesis.
commonScope.topology: Ordinary Berkovich opens, germs and sheaves.
commonScope.tests: All original compactly supported smooth complementary CLD tests and actual finite moment refinements, including rank loss.
commonScope.background: A symmetric CLD middle-positive current S of degree (p,p), separately closed under d-prime and d-double-prime; q=n−p.
commonScope.warning: Each result keeps its own stronger hypotheses. These conventions do not certify a proof or identify the different completions.

status_convention: Theorem inputs retain the status of their source manuscripts. Every item below is open; a sufficient route and a special-case reduction do not close their parent problem.

open_sufficient_routes.known: The existing packing criterion is sufficient; direct finite-family energy bounds would imply it.

items.title: Descent of actual analytic relations
items.statement: For every finite K/Q_p with its original norm, every good Hausdorff boundaryless quasi-smooth ordinary germ of pure dimension n, every 1<=b<=n and every finite signed admissible continuous closed-cell PL/PS presentation P with actual delta curvature kappa_b(P)=0, there is an ordinary representative chosen for P on which A_S(P)=0 for every symmetric middle-positive separately d-prime and d-double-prime closed background S of degree p<=n-b, on all original compact smooth complementary CLD tests and all actual refinements including rank loss. Admissible scalars have their existing full delta curvature and are finite differences of continuous classical psh functions.
known_cases: Degree one; potential independence and the continuous-coefficient curvature module.
Quadratic finite presentations with s_f(x)<=2, in arbitrary ambient dimension.
Quadratic normal-three supplied models on the ordinary puncture; central vanishing in specified sufficient cases.
The established local weakly approximable background class, within its testing scope.
items.next_mathematical_step: Prove joint wall-flux cancellation for the realized critical pair; then general-germ return and higher coupled relations.
excluded_variants: Checking a single tropical chart or only a skeleton.
Replacing the original field or norm.
Dropping lower/rank-losing faces.
Concluding variable-PS coefficients, arbitrary current pullback or GK testing solely from the scalar conjecture.
items.statementTex:
Let $n\ge1$, $1\le b\le n$, and let $P$ be a finite signed admissible
PL/PS presentation at an ordinary germ $(X,x)$ over the fixed $K$.  Suppose
$\kappa_b(P)=0$ as an actual analytic delta-form germ.  There is an
ordinary representative $U$ of this germ, chosen for $P$, such that
for every $0\le p\le n-b$ and every allowed background $S$ of bidegree
$(p,p)$ on $U$,
\begin{equation}
                              \A_S(P)=0\quad\hbox{on }U.
                              
\end{equation}
The equality holds on every original compact smooth complementary CLD
test and after every actual refinement of the presentation.  The field,
its absolute value and the carrier of $S$ remain the given ones.

items.title: Cancellation of the realized critical pairing
items.statement: For every supplied original smooth normal-three model germ, finite admissible continuous closed-cell PL/PS quadratic actual zero P, allowed degree-one S and common protected moment presentation, the spherical expression sum c_alpha(integral h_alpha^1 k_alpha^1 d sigma - integral d_S h_alpha^1 tensor d_S k_alpha^1 : d M) is zero. The pair (Z_0,M) must arise jointly from the original relation and background.
known_cases: Vanishing critical density nu.
An actual full-exact leading-energy identity on a neighborhood of the whole protected central fiber.
Each scalar first jet is one ambient linear function.
Previously established bounded-potential and W_loc background cases.
items.next_mathematical_step: Use actual-zero geometry to cancel the critical wall flux while retaining charged coefficient walls and mixed entries.
excluded_variants: Arbitrary real divergence-free PSD spherical measures are analytically realized.
The homogeneous first-jet formal relation is automatically an actual zero.
Finite/critical mass growth alone removes a Dirac residual.
Punctured local primitives automatically glue globally.

items.statement: For every actual signed PL-zero germ of mixed degree b>=2, does the unchanged carrier-CLN seminorm q^{U,b}_{F,L}(P) vanish at every required compact stage for the original absolute cap carrier F and the specified harmonic/ordinary-zero-product/ambient-cycle generator space?

items.statementTex:

for every required compact stage $L$ and the original absolute cap

items.title: Literal energy-dual strong continuity
items.statement: For a fixed allowed S on a strict Laurent box, suppose a positive Radon measure annihilates the relative null ideal, all completed Borel differences are literally integrable, and its integral functional is bounded on the entire energy-difference Banach space. Does I(u_j,u)->0 imply integral |u_j-u| d mu ->0 for every strong row? No finite-total-mass hypothesis is added.
known_cases: Source-dominated data
Specified capacity-dominated classes
Existing sufficient ordered-rooftop and finite-minorant reductions
items.next_mathematical_step: Prove fixed-S ordered-rooftop continuity or the weaker finite-minorant sublinear budget, or construct a positive literal datum satisfying all hypotheses that fails continuity.
excluded_variants: The coefficient-one rooftop energy inequality (false).
A uniform energy-only modulus for changing backgrounds (false).
Norm boundedness on one witness row replaces the global ED bound.
A nonliteral dual counterexample settles the literal measure question.
items.statementTex:

       I(u_j,u)\longrightarrow0\quad\overset{?}{\Longrightarrow}\quad
       \int_V|u_j-u|\,\dd\mu\longrightarrow0
                       \qquad(u_j,u\in\C)
                         
\end{equation}

items.statementTex:

Determine the corresponding existence, uniqueness and stability
theorems in $\C$, together with precise obstructions outside these
classes.

of singularity.  Construct the associated envelopes and comparison
theorems, specifying their ordinary domains, boundary conditions and
relative null ideals.  Describe how these invariants change under
proper geometric modifications in mapping classes for which the

items.statementTex:
For a specified class of adelic metrized line bundles on a
quasi-projective variety, define local finite-energy intersection
terms that extend the established continuous ones.  Find explicit
summability and boundary conditions under which their sum defines a
global intersection pairing, independent of approximation and
compatible with the product formula.  Prove the resulting variation,
projection and positivity statements under stated geometric
positivity hypotheses.
